title: Product
description: What people are actually doing with the platform, from the analytics event stream in Postgres. Distinct from the technical dashboards: nothing here comes from Prometheus, because adoption is discrete events, not time series.

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM analytics_events ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily events by category
panels.description: The shape of platform use over time. A category dropping to zero is usually a client that stopped emitting, not users who stopped acting — check against a deploy before reading it as a product signal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', occurred_at) AS time,
       event_category AS metric,
       count(*) AS value
  FROM analytics_events
 WHERE environment = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(DISTINCT workspace_id) AS "Active workspaces"
  FROM analytics_events
 WHERE environment = '$env' AND occurred_at > now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: First-time milestones (30d)
panels.description: NOTE: the `first_*` events in this funnel are defined in the event whitelist but are not yet emitted by the application, so those steps read zero. That is a known instrumentation gap, not a conversion cliff.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_name AS "Step", count(DISTINCT workspace_id) AS "Workspaces"
  FROM analytics_events
 WHERE environment = '$env'
   AND event_category = 'onboarding'
   AND occurred_at > now() - interval '30 days'
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT event_name AS "Step", count(*) AS "Events"
  FROM analytics_events
 WHERE environment = '$env'
   AND event_category = 'architect'
   AND occurred_at > now() - interval '30 days'
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top events (7d)
panels.description: Count AND distinct workspaces, deliberately. A high count from one workspace is one enthusiastic customer; the same count spread across thirty is adoption.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_name AS "Event", event_category AS "Category",
       count(*) AS "Count", count(DISTINCT workspace_id) AS "Workspaces"
  FROM analytics_events
 WHERE environment = '$env' AND occurred_at > now() - interval '7 days'
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) AS time,
       event_name AS metric, count(*) AS value
  FROM analytics_events
 WHERE environment = '$env'
   AND event_name IN ('workflow_run_succeeded','workflow_run_failed','workflow_run_cancelled')
   AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
